source_issue.title: Deployment documentation needs to show Seamless mode first, rather then classic "simple"

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the ordering of deployment documentation for the Plone Volto project. It's suggested that the "Seamless mode" deployment method should be prioritized over the older "Simple deployment" method.

## What needs to be done
1. Refactor the navigation items under the "Deploying" section to place "Seamless mode" first.
2. Update the "Simple deployment" documentation to add a deprecation warning, highlighting that this method requires `plone.restapi` < 2.0 and is recommended only for Plone 5.2 and older.

## Helpful background
Current navigation leads with "Simple deployment," which can confuse users. The "Seamless mode" provides a more current installation method, especially for newer Plone versions. The discussions point out that the documentation needs a clearer distinction between the two methods.

## Good first steps
- Review the current deployment documentation: [Deploying](https://6.dev-docs.plone.org/volto/deploying/index.html).
- Update the navigation structure and include deprecation warnings in the "Simple deployment" documentation.
- Collaborate with team members if you have questions or need guidance on how to implement these changes.
```
